title: Export
xfTip: Money moved between your accounts. Left out by default because it is neither income nor spending.
cp: Credit card bill payments from the bank
cpTip: The bank side of a card bill. Left out by default because the purchases are already listed on the card.
fut: Upcoming payments and bills that have not happened yet
futTip: Items the bank listed ahead of time, or bills the app expects. They are not real transactions yet, so they are left out unless you switch this on.
everything: Everything in the app as one file (JSON), the same as the backup.
done: Downloaded {name}. Look in your Downloads folder.

w.txD: One row per transaction, with the columns you pick
w.catD: Each category, month by month, with a total
w.billsD: Regular, irregular and one-off bills the app tracks
w.accountsD: Every account with its current balance
w.auditD: The history of changes made in the app
w.allD: The full data of the app in one file
